# The same 100.00 USD arriving against `Assets:Due From Director`, which is
# CAD, with a CAD wire fee beside it.
#
# The fee is genuinely CAD — it was charged in CAD and belongs in a CAD expense
# account — so it does not go when `Assets:Due From Director` does. The entry
# stays part CAD, which is what makes this different from
# money_booked_to_a_cad_account.txt: there, both remaining sides were
# USD and the transaction could be requoted in USD with no rate anywhere.
#
# Here it cannot. Requoting is impossible with a CAD split still in the entry,
# so the receivable split would have to carry a USD amount against a CAD value,
# and the ratio between them is a rate nobody stated. Measured on the
# equivalent shape: 1000.00 USD against −1420.00 CAD, an implied 1.42.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the currencies, rather than a
# book carrying an invented rate.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-02-26 * "Money in, net of a fee"

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
